statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-45927: S-Lang crashes with an arithmetic exception in tt_sprintf() when it uses a crafted terminfo entry, for example one placed in the user's ~/.terminfo (https://lists.jedsoft.org/lists/slang-users/2023/0000003.html). The S-Lang maintainer traced the report to a corrupt terminfo file whose string offsets S-Lang does not validate, and proposed a bounds check on the offset in _pSLtt_tigetstr() (https://lists.jedsoft.org/lists/slang-users/2023/0000004.html, https://lists.jedsoft.org/lists/slang-users/2023/0000005.html). Debian lists trixie's 2.3.3-5 as vulnerable and the issue as unfixed in unstable, with negligible security impact: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2023-45927. The DHI Debian repository publishes the slang2 source for Debian 13 as a single rebuild of Debian's 2.3.3-5 (libslang2, libslang2-dev, libslang2-pic, libslang2-modules, slsh and their debug-symbol packages, amd64 and arm64), whose shipped changelog adds no change beyond the rebuild. Debian's 2.3.3-5 source, including its patches, does not add that check to _pSLtt_tigetstr() in src/sltermin.c, so every published build is affected.
